stage: Judgements written in tool command before inference, but initial save failed with SyntaxError. Corrected file saved during inference after seeing the first three q145 scores (all 100). No prediction content or proposed labels inspected before this corrected save. This is a protocol deviation, not a fully precommitted blind reference.
limitations: Same chat and visible source reference; only four independent questions. First three q145 scores visible before successful save.

rubric_findings.145: c3 heavily weights an implication of unequal variances; c2 combines separate variances and df without subweights.
rubric_findings.251: Reference wording about more expensive indexing for cross-encoder is misleading: standard cross-encoder has no reusable independent document index. Reranking is an application, not definition.
rubric_findings.351: COCO AP uses interpolated precision at 101 recall levels; area under PR is reasonable interview shorthand. Gap suggests localization problems, not proof classes are correct.
rubric_findings.449: Inverse LR scaling compensates uniform gradient scaling for appropriate update rules such as plain SGD, not arbitrary optimizers/clipping/decay. Different randomness changes exact realization, not necessarily expected gradient; matched per-example randomness can preserve equality. c1/c2 overlap.

criteria.evidence_context: Bi-encoder отдельно кодирует запрос и документ, поэтому векторы документов можно заранее сохранить в индексе и быстро искать похожие. Cross-encoder совместно обрабатывает пару, учитывая взаимодействия токенов, поэтому обычно применяют его как reranker к небольшому числу кандидатов. Качество сравнения может быть выше, но совместный расчёт каждой пары дороже и медленнее; выигрыш проверяют на своих данных.
criteria.rationale: Separate encoding and reusable indexed document embeddings.
